_what: Real device output, captured on the bench and kept as a test fixture.
_why: runs/ is gitignored, so a guard that reads only it protects one machine. These are verbatim `evidence` blocks from published bench runs: byte-exact readings, where the registered decode marker and expectation MUST both match or the registry is wrong. A capture is a fact and does not rot — an edit to registry.py now has to get past every reading ever taken, not just the next one.
_never: Do not edit these to make a test pass. They are what the devices said. If one stops matching, the registry changed and the registry is what to look at.
